title: RealistifyLITE
description: Vanilla Minecraft. Just actually beautiful.(VERSION 1.21.11 RELEASE)
body: # Realistify - Lite Edition ![RealistifyLITEtitle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ccbfe366eccb5b263f610eba3efa2a499a81028.png) > *Vanilla Minecraft. Just actually beautiful.* --- ## ✨ Overview **Realistify LITE** is a Vanilla+ modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric that turns the base game into a visually stunning experience — without changing how it plays. Every visual system has been rebuilt from the ground up: connected glass, realistic grass edges, dynamic lighting from held torches, falling leaf particles, custom skies, 3D player skin layers, random entity textures, and full shader support via Iris. You're still playing Minecraft. It just looks like you aren't. This modpack is fully **client-side** — it works on any Vanilla server or SMP without requiring server-side installation. This modpack focuses on: - Maximum visual realism within the Vanilla+ philosophy - Complete OptiFine replacement with modern Fabric mods - High-performance rendering so realism doesn't tank your FPS - Full Iris shader support with curated shader recommendations - Zero gameplay changes — pure immersion upgrade --- ## 🔥 LITE vs FULL comparison | | Realistify Lite | Realistify | |---|---|---| | Target hardware | Mid-range (4–8 GB) | High-end (8 GB+) | | Sound | Vanilla | Footsteps + reverb + biome audio | | Terrain | Vanilla | Terralith — 85+ biomes, realistic cliffs | | Seasons | None | Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter | | Animals | Vanilla | Naturalist — realistic animal behaviors | | LOD rendering | None | Distant Horizons — see for 128+ chunks | | Rain | Vanilla | Particle Rain — physics-accurate droplets | | Food | Vanilla | Farmer's Delight — full cooking system | | Mod count | ~47 | ~70 | --- ## 🚀 Features - 🌿 **Falling Leaves** — Leaf blocks emit soft ambient leaf particles - 💡 **Dynamic Lighting** — Held torches, glowing items, and more light up the world around you - 🔲 **Connected Textures** — Glass, bookshelves, and more connect seamlessly via Continuity - 🌄 **Custom Sky Support** — FabricSkyboxes enables custom skyboxes from compatible resource packs - 🦊 **3D Entities** — EMF + ETF bring random, emissive, and custom entity textures and models - 🧍 **3D Skin Layers** — Player skin outer layers fully rendered in 3D - 🌱 **Better Grass** — Grass realistically spreads to the sides of dirt blocks - 🎮 **Full Shader Support** — Iris Shaders with Complementary Reimagined recommended for mid-range PCs - 🗺️ **Minimap + World Map** — Xaero's Minimap and World Map included - ✅ **Zero OptiFine** — Completely OptiFine-free. All features are covered by modern replacements. --- ## ⚡ Performance Realistify LITE is built on the current Fabric performance mod meta — the same stack used by top optimization packs. Visual realism upgrades are layered on top of a fully optimized engine, so your FPS stays high even with shaders. Performance mods included: - **Sodium** — Rendering engine replacement - **Lithium** — Game logic optimization - **FerriteCore** — Memory reduction - **ImmediatelyFast** — Immediate mode rendering boost - **Entity Culling + More Culling** — Skip rendering what you can't see - **C2ME** — Multi-core chunk generation - **ModernFix** — Faster startup and lower memory baseline - **Dynamic FPS** — Caps FPS when Minecraft is unfocused - **Exordium, Noisium, ScalableLux, BadOptimizations, Krypton** — Full optimization stack --- ## 🎨 Shader Recommendations RealistifyLITE ships with Iris Shaders — no shader is selected by default. Recommended shaders: | Performance Level | Recommended Shader | |---|---| | Mid-range (recommended) | SuperDuperVanilla | | High-end | Complemntary Reimagined | | Lower-end | Sildur's Vibrant Shaders Lite | SuperDuperVanilla are included. --- ## 🧩 Included Mods ### Performance (17 mods) Sodium, Sodium Extra, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, More Culling, ModernFix, Memory Leak Fix, Dynamic FPS, Krypton, FastQuit, BadOptimizations, C2ME, Noisium, ScalableLux, Exordium ### Visual Realism (10 mods) Iris Shaders, Continuity, LambDynamicLights, LambdaBetterGrass, Falling Leaves, Entity Model Features (EMF), Entity Texture Features (ETF), 3D Skin Layers, FabricSkyboxes, OptiGUI ### Quality of Life (14 mods) Jade, AppleSkin, Xaero's Minimap, Xaero's World Map, Inventory Profiles Next, BetterF3, Mouse Tweaks, ShulkerBoxTooltip, Mod Menu, Reese's Sodium Options, No Chat Reports, Better Statistics Screen, Enchantment Descriptions, Zoomify ### Optional Nvidium *(NVIDIA GPUs only)*, Capes, Dark Loading Screen, Better Ping Display, ThreadTweak ### Libraries Fabric API, Cloth Config, YetAnotherConfigLib, Architectury API --- ## 💻 System Requirements **Minimum (no shaders):** - RAM: 4 GB allocated - CPU: Any quad-core - GPU: Dedicated GPU recommended (integrated graphics may work without shaders) - Java: 21 (Adoptium / Eclipse Temurin) **Recommended (with shaders):** - RAM: 6 GB allocated - CPU: Modern quad-core or better - GPU: Any dedicated mid-range GPU (GTX 1060 / RX 580 or better) - Java: 21 (Adoptium / Eclipse Temurin) --- ## ⚙️ JVM Arguments Add these to your launcher for best performance: ``` XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1HeapWastePercent=5 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 ``` *Launcher locations: Prism → Edit Instance > Settings > Java | Modrinth App → Instance > Settings > Java | CurseForge → Profile Settings > Java* --- ## 🌐 Multiplayer Realistify LITE is **fully client-side** — all visual and performance mods work without server-side installation. Join any Vanilla 1.21.1 server and enjoy full visual upgrades. No permissions needed from the server. --- ## 🎯 Perfect For - Players who want Minecraft to look incredible without a modded overhaul - SMP players who want client-side visual improvements on vanilla servers - Shader enthusiasts who want a curated, optimized Fabric base - Mid-range PC users who want high FPS with great visuals - Vanilla fans who are curious about what the game can look like --- ## 🔧 OptiFine Replacement Notice RealistifyLITE is **100% OptiFine-free**. All OptiFine features are replaced: | OptiFine Feature | Replacement | |---|---| | Shaders | Iris Shaders | | Connected Textures | Continuity | | Dynamic Lighting | LambDynamicLights | | Custom Entity Models | Entity Model Features (EMF) | | Custom Entity Textures | Entity Texture Features (ETF) | | Custom GUI | OptiGUI | | Zoom | Zoomify | | Better Grass | LambdaBetterGrass | | Custom Skies | FabricSkyboxes | --- ## 📦 Version **1.0.0** — Initial Release - Full visual realism mod stack - Complete performance optimization base - Optimized configs pre-applied - Shader support via Iris - Client-side compatible --- ## 📝 Notes - Shaders are **included** — if more are needed download separately - Nvidium is marked optional — AMD/Intel GPU users should disable it - All configs are pre-applied for best out-of-box experience - No gameplay changes — 100% vanilla mechanics --- NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.
